verdict.rationale: Project-local skills are documented: a skill at `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md` creates `/deploy`, and skills are defined as filesystem artifacts in their own directories, so they can be committed with a repo. Plugins are described as reusable 'across projects', but no evidence documents a user-global skills location or a scope choice at install time. The only hands-on install that landed in `./.claude/skills/` used third-party `npx skills` tooling, which earns no product credit. Missing for 10: documented user-global skill directory, an explicit install-scope option (e.g. project vs user flag on `/plugin install`), independent corroboration of both scopes.
